acceptance_criteria: The master plan clearly distinguishes raw point-cloud source data, causal student input, offline teacher information, and AI annotator input.
Planner/map-derived labels remain the core supervision; AI labels are confidence-scored auxiliary proposals requiring rule and human audit.
Supervised structural representation becomes the Gate-2 main route and self-supervision becomes an optional fallback or regularizer.
BEV remains the first student route, direct point-cloud encoding is activated only by documented BEV failure, and the two routes are not developed in parallel.
Gate 0 remains GATE_MIXED, the V3 dataset remains NONE, and no experimental operation is performed.
baseline: Previous V3 plan with self-supervised representation learning as the first Gate-2 route and no explicit AI-assisted annotation contract.

estimated_cost.compute: Documentation and CPU-only governance tests; no dataset, AI API labeling, GPU, ROS, or simulator

expected_evidence: Updated MASTER PLAN V3 Gate 1-3 sections
Detailed supervised structural learning strategy document
Updated Data Card template, project status, and decision log
Machine-readable task summary and governance test log
method: Revise Gate 1-3 around point-cloud source data, causal BEV student input, planner-consistent objective supervision, AI-assisted structural-role proposals, human/rule quality control, and supervised lightweight representation learning.
question: Can the V3 master plan incorporate supervised structural learning and AI-assisted annotation without weakening causal deployment, strict-test isolation, or Gate separation?
